predictions.selection_reason: assignment of element text property with user-controlled content -> direct DOM manipulation -> potential XSS if property is tainted
predictions.source_summary: DOM element text content from existing HTML elements selected via document.querySelectorAll or direct element references
predictions.sink_summary: DOM manipulation via textContent/innerText assignment and insertAdjacentHTML calls that can execute HTML
predictions.guard_summary: No explicit sanitization of text content before assignment or HTML insertion; relies on browser's textContent safety but innerText may preserve formatting
predictions.risk_pattern: Self-assignment of element text property followed by HTML insertion without content sanitization, potentially allowing script execution if text contains malicious HTML
enclosing_conditions: if (span) condition checking for existing shaved content
predictions.context_summary: Text truncation function that manipulates DOM element content, removes existing ellipsis, reassigns text, then inserts new HTML content
unresolved_facts: Whether text content originates from user-controlled sources
Whether innerText vs textContent behavior difference creates XSS vector
Whether existing content validation occurs before shave function call
